objectives.text: Count a group of up to 10 objects by touching each one
Recognize that the last number counted tells how many objects are in the group
Identify written numbers from 1 to 10 in order
Combine two physical groups of objects together to find a total.
Explain how counting all the objects together tells us the total amount.
Identify the plus sign (+) and equal sign (=) as math tools for putting groups together.
Count physical objects grouped in sets of five to find the total amount.
Identify the number pattern where every number ends in either zero or five.
Explain the skip counting sequence up to 100 using a number grid.
Model two-digit addition problems using base-ten blocks to physically group tens and ones.
Identify when a ones column sum reaches ten or more and requires a trade.
Explain the step-by-step process of carrying over a new ten to the tens column.
Solve standard vertical addition equations that require regrouping.
